name: AnimeIowa
blurb: Iowa's first anime convention (est. 1997), held each summer at the Hyatt Regency Coralville with voice actor guests, cosplay and DJs.

editions.venue: Hyatt Regency Coralville Hotel & Conference Center
editions.evidence: JSON-LD Event on the homepage/guests page: 'Convention Time – Anime Iowa: Anime Valley' 2027-07-30 to 2027-08-01 @ Hyatt Regency Coralville; page text: '2027 July 30th – August 1st'; the Hotel & Rooms page gives the full venue address: 'Hyatt Regency Coralville Hotel & Conference Center 300 E 9th Street Coralville, IA., 52241'.

notes: The seed location (Des Moines, IA) is wrong: the con's own Hotel & Rooms page gives its address as 300 E 9th Street, Coralville, IA 52241 (Hyatt Regency Coralville), so city/region were corrected to Coralville, IA. On the Guests page, four people (Carrie Savage, Patrick Pedraza, Brian Beacock, Chris Tergliafera) and the Artist Guest (Steve Bennett) had photo cards with no bio text at all, so their known-for came from reading each one's own individual bio subpage (e.g. animeiowa.com/guests/carrie-savage/) instead. 'Incendiary NPCs' is a named section with 7 photos (#11-17) and no bio text anywhere (its guessed bio-page URL 404s); since groups are one guest per RESEARCH.md, this is recorded as a single guest using the largest photo (#11), with known-for left blank since nothing describes what they do. Semetary Cosplay's card likewise carries only the 'Cosplay Guest' label with no further text, so known-for is blank for them too. Werkforce (a drag/cosplay performance crew) and Samurai Dan (a touring samurai-sword martial-arts educator, founder of the Akita-Ken Dojo) had full card text but don't map cleanly onto a single cat; Werkforce is filed as 'cosplay' since their own text calls it 'cosplay drag', and Samurai Dan and Kamikaze Snowmen (described only as the ceremony emcees) are filed as 'other'. No organizer company/nonprofit name was found on the pages sampled. Verify pass (2026-10-05): current -- the guests page itself carries JSON-LD Event data for 'Convention Time – Anime Iowa: Anime Valley' 2027-07-30 to 2027-08-01 plus calendar entries like 'Set up For Anime Iowa 2027!', with no stale-year, 'coming soon' or cancellation wording found, so the lineup stands.
